subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: what kind of stories did aesop tell asked anwar fables replied mrs amin do you know what fables are no replied anwar well continued mrs amin fables are stories with a message or a moral. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "What kind of stories did Aesop tell?" asked Anwar. "Fables, replied Mrs. Amin. "Do you know what fables are?" "No," replied Anwar. "Well," continued Mrs. Amin. "Fables are stories with a message or a moral." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 219
